title: The Windy Walk
can_do: 根据天气（风、冷）选衣服，并说出“因为……所以……”的理由。

conversation_move.label: choose clothing for the weather with a reason

trigger: It is windy outside and the family is about to leave, so Child connects the weather to his clothing choice.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Look outside. It's really windy today.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Will the wind blow my hat away?

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: It might, if it's not on tight.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Then I'll wear my hoodie, so my ears stay warm.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Good choice. Hood up or down?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Up, please! The wind makes my ears cold.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Yes! Windy days need warm ears.

replay_cards.title: The sunny hat
replay_cards.setting: Bright sun before a garden walk.
replay_cards.challenge: Child connects the strong sun to the wide-brim hat and explains why he picks it over the cap.

replay_cards.title: Snowy morning
replay_cards.setting: The first snowy day of winter.
replay_cards.challenge: Child chooses mittens with a reason — warmer fingers together — and accepts the scarf Mom adds.

parent_support: 出门前把天气说给孩子听，让他自己决定穿什么。
孩子的选择可行就照办；明显不行时问“风这么大，帽子会怎样”，引导他自己修正。
复述一句“冷天穿连帽衫”，把选择变成一句因果。
